It pays where coupling hurts: domains that conflict, many domains with small shares each, rollout latencies that differ by orders of magnitude, and teams that want to add, drop or fix a domain without retraining the rest. It gives ground where coupling helps: when domains share skills, multi-task RL or the plain sum moves faster along the shared directions, and OPM recovers that only through larger trainer steps. The transfer term and visibility, both logged at every rendezvous, tell which situation a run is in."]}],["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","span",null,{"className":"am-runin","children":"Limitations."}]," The guarantees assume lossless rounds, and we have not shown that they exist at LLM scale. In the 4B merge the residual after 30 CG iterations is still 16% of drift on held-out prompts, and the reasoning domains overlap. The informative statements at realistic drift are second-order or about KL, not reward. The trajectory Fisher grows with tokens, so long-response domains get more weight in shared directions. OPM keeps one model copy per domain in memory. The Fisher is estimated from a subsample, and the evidence for the guarded merge comes from one two-domain test. In the one-shot merge, a stale metric tied the on-policy one on benchmarks. All results are at 4B and 9B on dense models; mixture-of-experts models and larger scales are untested."]}],["$","p",null,{"children":[["$","span",null,{"className":"am-runin","children":"Related work."}]," The barycenter objective comes from Distral and Divide-and-Conquer RL"," ",["$","span",null,{"className":"am-cite","data-cite":"","children":[[null,["$","label",null,{"className":"am-sn","children":[["$","input",null,{"type":"checkbox","className":"am-sn-toggle","aria-label":"Reference 12: Distral: Robust Multitask Reinforcement Learning"}],["$","sup",null,{"className":"am-sn-num","children":12}],["$","span",null,{"className":"am-sn-note am-sn-repeat","role":"note","children":[["$","span",null,{"className":"am-sn-n","children":[12,"."]}]," ",["$","a",null,{"className":"am-sn-short","href":"https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.04175","target":"_blank","rel":"noreferrer","title":"Distral: Robust Multitask Reinforcement Learning","children":"Teh et al, 2017"}],["$","span",null,{"className":"am-sn-full","children":"Yee Whye Teh, Victor Bapst, Wojciech Marian Czarnecki, John Quan, James Kirkpatrick, Raia Hadsell, Nicolas Heess, Razvan Pascanu.
